caption: The drawing features a square with a beige or light tan background, containing a graphic depiction of a stylized flower with one central red blossom and three red flower buds. The central blossom has rounded petals and is filled with a repetitive small green star or asterisk-like pattern. The three buds, positioned at the top left, top right, and bottom right corners, are elongated and similarly filled with the same green star pattern. Green stems and leaves connect the flower and buds, with the leaves also decorated with a small repeated dot pattern. The lower left corner of the square is filled with a green triangle, which matches the color and pattern of the leaves. Below the main image are two small sample swatches: the left one is green with a black dotted pattern, and the right one is red with the same type of green star pattern found on the flowers. The artist's name, "Charlotte Angus," is printed beneath the sample swatches.
title: Quilt Block
